title: Craftouille
description: Craftouille is a Minecraft 1.21–26.1.2 minigame server
body: Craftouille is a Minecraft 1.21–26.1.2 minigame server—one of the few to offer a completely new gaming experience. Dive into a competitive yet friendly world created by streamer Nat0uille, discover game modes with innovative features, and explore a unique way to participate in community events.
